assumptions: Replacement level is recomputed separately for EVERY completed week, using that week's own historical roster snapshot and that week's own Sleeper projections -- not today's roster applied retroactively.

A player (rostered or waiver) only counts for a given week's ranking if they were projected for more than 0 points that week -- this is the sole filter (covers byes, injuries, and non-factors in one rule); see not_playing_by_week.
Waiver pool for a week = that week's Sleeper-projected players (also projected > 0) not matched to any of the 14 rosters that week.

A band's baseline for a week = average of its members' REAL actual Yahoo points that week (not a projection). Waiver members are resolved to a real Yahoo player_id first (via another week's roster if they were ever rostered, else a Yahoo player search) so they're scored the same way as rostered members; any name that couldn't be resolved at all is excluded from the average and listed in unresolved_waiver_players.
A band member who didn't play a given week (no actual data, or an exact 0.0) is excluded from that week's average rather than dragging it to 0.

Each currently-rostered player's PABB = sum, over every completed week, of (that week's actual points - that week's replacement level for their position); a week they didn't play contributes exactly 0.
p (flex share) is computed fresh for each week from that week's own flex-slot outcome, not a fixed constant.
